about_pillar_data_desc: We integrate the official inventories of MINCETUR, DIRCETUR Arequipa, AUTOCOLCA and INEI into a single repository with no duplication.
about_pillar_privacy_desc: Every survey and indicator collected is automatically anonymized, safeguarding the tourist's privacy.
about_pillar_tech_desc: Modular infrastructure ready for PostGIS, heat maps, tourist flow analytics and Supabase integration.
about_pillar_verified_desc: We distinguish verified government sources from community contributions through transparent moderation and role-based RLS.
eco_card_discover_desc: Integration into the official rewards catalog of the TAFA Explorer Pass. Tourists unlock exclusive experiences when they visit your establishment.
eco_card_requirements_desc: Active RUC in good standing, a current municipal operating license and a commitment to WCAG 2.1 accessible infrastructure.
eco_card_standards_desc: Official verification of your offering with the regional DIRCETUR / MINCETUR seal, safeguarding the quality and reputation of the entire ecosystem.
eco_submit_error: We could not register your application. Check your connection and try again, or write to us on WhatsApp at +51 921 378 349.
eco_subtitle: We connect traditional restaurants, lodgings, artisans and formalized tour operators with thousands of visitors through the Discover More program.
eco_title: Become part of the National Smart Tourism Ecosystem
map_description: Geolocated attractions and picanterías from the official inventory in Supabase. The view covers the Arequipa metropolitan area; provincial destinations (Colca, Cotahuasi, Toro Muerto, Salinas, Mejía) are covered further down. Click any pin to see the details.
partners_empty: There are no partners registered in this category yet.
partners_subtitle: Partners of the Sociedad Picantera, AGAR, AHORA Arequipa, AVIT and COLITUR. Scan the QR code at the establishment to validate your visit and earn TAFA Points.
problem_card_atomizado_desc: Micro and small businesses (MYPE) without the individual capacity to create integrated packages or invest in digital channels.
problem_card_fragmentada_desc: Tourism data is scattered across multiple agencies with no integration between them.
problem_card_sin_digital_desc: Local cuisine, picanterías and chicherías have no structured digital visibility.
problem_card_turista_desc: Visitors feel they have seen it all in 1 day because the visible offering is concentrated in the city center alone.

qr_review_saved_desc: Your feedback strengthens the quality of tourism in Arequipa.
qr_review_title: How was your experience at this place?
qr_reward_caption: Official reward for validating your visit on site

qr_success_points_added: +{{points}} TAFA Points have been added to your profile for visiting {{name}}.

routes_andagua_desc: A fascinating volcanic field, unique in South America, with more than 80 extinct low-rise volcanic cones (from 50 to 300 meters).
routes_choqolaqa_desc: A surreal landscape of white rock towers resembling an ancient citadel petrified beneath Andean skies.
routes_cotahuasi_desc: The deepest canyon on earth (3,535 m). A pristine sanctuary of waterfalls such as Sipia, Puya Raimondi forests and the Luicho hot springs.
routes_cotahuasi_pilar_1: Panoramic cable car over the Sipia Waterfall
routes_cotahuasi_pilar_2: Luxury thermal and spa complex in Luicho
routes_cotahuasi_pilar_3: Fast access roads and highway infrastructure
routes_culebrillas_sillar_desc: Winding canyons of white sillar (volcanic stone) with pre-Inca petroglyphs and working quarries where Arequipa's stone is extracted.
routes_imata_desc: A striking waterfall surrounded by giant stone columns carved by wind erosion on the Andean plateau.
routes_imata_pilar_1: Roadside stop with heating and thermal clothing
routes_puerto_inka_desc: An ancient Inca port where shellfish were harvested for the Inca in Cusco. A unique combination of Pacific coast and Qhapaq Ñan heritage.
routes_puerto_inka_nombre: Puerto Inka and Quebrada de la Waca
routes_puerto_inka_pilar_1: Enhancement of the coastal Inca Trail
routes_puerto_inka_pilar_2: Pier for water sports and kayaking
routes_quilca_matarani_desc: Historic bays with rich marine biodiversity, steep cliffs and cuisine made with the day's fresh catch.
routes_quilca_matarani_pilar_1: Boat circuit for sea lions and penguins
routes_quilca_matarani_pilar_2: Seafood gastronomic boulevard on the pier
routes_quilca_matarani_pilar_3: Guided diving and cave kayaking route
routes_salinas_desc: A sanctuary of flamingos and salt mirrors at over 4,300 m.a.s.l. at the foot of the Pichu Pichu volcano.
routes_subtitle: We diversify the tourism offering of the 8 provinces with technology, astrotourism, cable cars, marine ecotourism and sustainable routes.
routes_title: Discover the 10 Routes and Innovations of Regional Tourism
routes_toromuerto_desc: One of the largest rock art fields in the world, with more than 5,000 engravings on volcanic rock created by pre-Inca cultures.
routes_toromuerto_nombre: Toro Muerto Petroglyphs and Majes Valley
routes_toromuerto_pilar_1: 3D Augmented Reality app for the engravings
routes_toromuerto_pilar_2: Rafting on the Majes river and quad biking
routes_uzuna_desc: A beautiful stretch of water surrounded by mountains, ideal for eco-friendly water sports and family picnics.
routes_uzuna_pilar_1: Sports pier for kayaks and paddle boards
routes_uzuna_pilar_2: Camping area equipped with solar showers
routes_uzuna_pilar_3: Food court serving local fried trout
safety_banner_info: Arequipa 2,335 m.a.s.l. · High UV Radiation · Use transport registered with DIRCETUR
safety_contact_hospital_desc: Emergency medical care in the Cercado
safety_contact_poltur_desc: Bilingual assistance for reports and protection
safety_modal_intro: Official emergency and immediate visitor assistance services in the Arequipa Region.
safety_soroche_text: Rest during your first 4 hours, drink coca tea and stay constantly hydrated before ascending to the Colca (3,630 m.a.s.l.).
stats_aliados_sub: with an active QR code in the directory
